summary: SpecLite validate found path portability issues in checked categories.

issues.impact: The planned write path could produce different results on case-insensitive filesystems.
issues.suggestedNextStep: Resolve the case-only path conflict before release.

issues.impact: The path crosses a symlink and cannot be proven to stay inside the target project.
issues.suggestedNextStep: Replace the symlink with a real project directory before release.

issues.impact: A workflow artifact path is not safely contained inside the target project.
issues.suggestedNextStep: Use a project-relative POSIX artifact path inside the configured artifact root.

issues.impact: An installer-owned or installer-controlled installed file no longer matches the files index boundary.
issues.suggestedNextStep: Run speclite validate and manually review the protected boundary before planning update or repair.

nextActions: Run speclite update --repair --json only for explicit installer-owned repair scenarios.
